questions.stem: A shopkeeper sells an article for \(3\) equal installments of Rs. \(2000\) each. If the rate of interest is \(10\%\) per annum, what is the cash price of the article?
A refrigerator costs Rs. \(18000\). It is sold for Rs. \(4000\) down and the balance in \(10\) equal monthly installments at \(12\%\) per annum simple interest. Find each installment.
questions.keySolution:
Balance amount = \(18000 - 4000 = Rs. 14000\)
Time = \(10\) months = \(10/12\) years
Simple Interest = \(14000 × 12 × (10/12) / 100 = Rs. 1400\)
Total amount to be paid in installments = \(14000 + 1400 = Rs. 15400\)
Each installment = \(15400 / 10 = Rs. 1540\)

questions.stem: A washing machine is available for Rs. \(12000\) cash or Rs. \(2000\) down and \(12\) monthly installments of Rs. \(950\) each. What is the rate of interest charged?
questions.keySolution:
Total installment price = \(2000 + 12 × 950 = Rs. 13400\)
Extra amount = \(13400 - 12000 = Rs. 1400\)
Principal for installments = \(12000 - 2000 = Rs. 10000\)
Time = \(12\) months = \(1\) year
Rate = \((1400 × 100) / (10000 × 1) = 14\%\)

questions.stem: If an article is sold for \(3\) equal annual installments of Rs. \(1000\) each at \(10\%\) compound interest, what is the cash price?
A laptop is sold for Rs. \(8000\) down and \(8\) monthly installments of Rs. \(2500\) each. If the cash price is Rs. \(25000\), find the rate of simple interest.
questions.keySolution:
Total installment price = \(8000 + 8 × 2500 = Rs. 28000\)
Extra amount = \(28000 - 25000 = Rs. 3000\)
Principal for installments = \(25000 - 8000 = Rs. 17000\)
Time = \(8\) months = \(2/3\) years
Rate = \((3000 × 100) / (17000 × 2/3) = 26.47\%\)

questions.stem: A car is available for Rs. \(200000\) cash or Rs. \(50000\) down and \(36\) equal monthly installments. If the interest rate is \(12\%\) per annum, find each installment.
questions.keySolution:
Balance amount = \(200000 - 50000 = Rs. 150000\)
Time = \(36\) months = \(3\) years
Using EMI formula:
EMI = \(P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1)\)
Where r = \(0.01\) (monthly), n = \(36\)
EMI = Rs. \(4985\) approximately

questions.stem: A furniture set costs Rs. \(24000\) cash or Rs. \(6000\) down and \(15\) monthly installments of Rs. \(1400\) each. What is the effective rate of interest?
questions.keySolution:
Total installment price = \(6000 + 15 × 1400 = Rs. 27000\)
Extra amount = \(27000 - 24000 = Rs. 3000\)
Principal for installments = \(24000 - 6000 = Rs. 18000\)
Time = \(15\) months = \(1.25\) years
Rate = \((3000 × 100) / (18000 × 1.25) = 13.33\%\)

questions.stem: A mobile phone is sold for Rs. \(1500\) down and \(10\) monthly installments of Rs. \(800\) each. If the cash price is Rs. \(8500\), what is the simple interest rate per annum?
questions.keySolution:
Total installment price = \(1500 + 10 × 800 = Rs. 9500\)
Extra amount = \(9500 - 8500 = Rs. 1000\)
Principal for installments = \(8500 - 1500 = Rs. 7000\)
Time = \(10\) months = \(10/12\) years
Rate = \((1000 × 100) / (7000 × 10/12) = 17.14\%\)

questions.stem: An air conditioner costs Rs. \(30000\). It is sold for \(20\%\) down payment and the rest in \(18\) equal monthly installments at \(15\%\) per annum simple interest. Find each installment.
A machine is sold for Rs. \(5000\) down and \(5\) equal annual installments of Rs. \(2000\) each. If the cash price is Rs. \(12000\), what is the compound interest rate?
questions.keySolution:
Present value of installments should equal \(12000 - 5000 = Rs. 7000\)
Let rate = r
\(7000 = 2000/(1+r) + 2000/(1+r)^2 + ... + 2000/(1+r)^5\)
Using trial and error or financial calculator
At r = \(15\%\), PV = Rs. \(6710\) approximately
Closest rate = \(15\%\)

questions.stem: A bike is available for Rs. \(45000\) cash or Rs. \(15000\) down and \(24\) monthly installments of Rs. \(1500\) each. What is the additional amount paid in installment scheme?
questions.keySolution:
Total installment price = \(15000 + 24 × 1500 = Rs. 51000\)
Cash price = Rs. \(45000\)
Additional amount = \(51000 - 45000 = Rs. 6000\)

questions.stem: An article is sold for Rs. \(2000\) down and \(6\) half-yearly installments of Rs. \(1000\) each at \(20\%\) per annum compound interest. Find the cash price.
questions.keySolution:
Half-yearly rate = \(20/2 = 10\%\)
Present value of installments:
PV = \(1000/(1.1) + 1000/(1.1)^2 + ... + 1000/(1.1)^6\)
Using formula for present value of annuity:
PV = \(1000 × [(1 - (1.1)^{-6})/0.1] = Rs. 4355\)
Cash price = \(2000 + 4355 = Rs. 6355\)

questions.stem: A washing machine costs Rs. \(16000\) cash or Rs. \(4000\) down and \(8\) quarterly installments of Rs. \(1800\) each. What is the rate of simple interest per annum?
questions.keySolution:
Total installment price = \(4000 + 8 × 1800 = Rs. 18400\)
Extra amount = \(18400 - 16000 = Rs. 2400\)
Principal for installments = \(16000 - 4000 = Rs. 12000\)
Time = \(8\) quarters = \(2\) years
Rate = \((2400 × 100) / (12000 × 2) = 10\%\)

questions.stem: A computer is available for Rs. \(35000\) cash. Alternatively, it can be purchased for Rs. \(10000\) down and \(20\) monthly installments of Rs. \(1500\) each. What is the extra amount paid in the installment scheme?
questions.keySolution:
Total installment price = \(10000 + 20 × 1500 = Rs. 40000\)
Cash price = Rs. \(35000\)
Extra amount = \(40000 - 35000 = Rs. 5000\)

questions.stem: A refrigerator is sold for \(3\) equal annual installments of Rs. \(8000\) each. If the compound interest rate is \(12\%\) per annum, what would be the cash price?
An article costs Rs. \(12000\) cash. It is sold for Rs. \(2000\) down and the balance in \(10\) equal monthly installments at \(24\%\) per annum simple interest. Find the amount of each installment.
questions.keySolution:
Balance amount = \(12000 - 2000 = Rs. 10000\)
Time = \(10\) months = \(10/12\) years
Simple Interest = \(10000 × 24 × (10/12) / 100 = Rs. 2000\)
Total amount in installments = \(10000 + 2000 = Rs. 12000\)
Each installment = \(12000 / 10 = Rs. 1200\)

questions.stem: A motorbike is sold for Rs. \(8000\) down payment and \(18\) monthly installments of Rs. \(2000\) each. If the cash price is Rs. \(40000\), what is the rate of simple interest charged per annum?
questions.keySolution:
Total installment price = \(8000 + 18 × 2000 = Rs. 44000\)
Extra amount = \(44000 - 40000 = Rs. 4000\)
Principal for installments = \(40000 - 8000 = Rs. 32000\)
Time = \(18\) months = \(1.5\) years
Rate = \((4000 × 100) / (32000 × 1.5) = 8.33\%\)

questions.stem: A furniture set is available for Rs. \(20000\) cash or \(25\%\) down and \(15\) equal monthly installments at \(20\%\) per annum simple interest. What is each installment?
A laptop is sold for \(4\) equal quarterly installments of Rs. \(12000\) each at \(20\%\) per annum compound interest. What is the present value?

Extra amount = \(9400 - 8000 = Rs. 1400\)
Principal for installments = \(8000 - 1000 = Rs. 7000\)

questions.stem: A machine is sold for Rs. \(10000\) down and \(5\) equal annual installments of Rs. \(5000\) each. If the cash price is Rs. \(30000\), what is the compound interest rate?
questions.keySolution:
Present value of installments = \(30000 - 10000 = Rs. 20000\)
We need: \(20000 = 5000/(1+r) + 5000/(1+r)^2 + ... + 5000/(1+r)^5\)
Using trial method or financial calculator:
At r = \(12\%\): PV ≈ Rs. \(18024\)
At r = \(10\%\): PV ≈ Rs. \(18954\)
Closest rate = \(12\%\)

questions.stem: A smartphone costs Rs. \(25000\) cash. It can be bought for Rs. \(5000\) down and \(24\) monthly installments. If the interest rate is \(18\%\) per annum, find each installment amount.
questions.keySolution:
Balance amount = \(25000 - 5000 = Rs. 20000\)
Time = \(24\) months = \(2\) years
Simple Interest = \(20000 × 18 × 2 / 100 = Rs. 7200\)
Total amount = \(20000 + 7200 = Rs. 27200\)
Each installment = \(27200 / 24 = Rs. 1133.33\)

questions.stem: An item is available for Rs. \(18000\) cash or Rs. \(3000\) down and \(20\) monthly installments of Rs. \(900\) each. What percentage extra is paid in the installment plan?
questions.keySolution:
Total installment price = \(3000 + 20 × 900 = Rs. 21000\)
Extra amount = \(21000 - 18000 = Rs. 3000\)
Percentage extra = \((3000 / 18000) × 100 = 16.67\%\)

questions.stem: A home theater system costs Rs. \(50000\) cash or \(30\%\) down and \(30\) monthly installments of Rs. \(1500\) each. What is the effective rate of interest per annum?
questions.keySolution:
Down payment = \(50000 × 30/100 = Rs. 15000\)
Total installment price = \(15000 + 30 × 1500 = Rs. 60000\)
Extra amount = \(60000 - 50000 = Rs. 10000\)
Principal for installments = \(50000 - 15000 = Rs. 35000\)
Time = \(30\) months = \(2.5\) years
Effective rate = \((10000 × 100) / (35000 × 2.5) = 11.43\%\)
